boarding: Inpatient admission is an administrative care milestone. Bed placement may follow while the patient receives care in a monitored boarding area under the admitting service. Boarding delays completion of the selected ward stabilization work, so actual care end and dependent evidence are regenerated. Unobserved completions remain censored. Boarding time is not silently counted as occupied licensed-bed time. Linked returns cannot start until the preceding care episode actually finishes; conflicting ambulatory appointments are deferred and retain their original scheduled slot.
triage: An ED oxygen saturation observation at arrival plus five minutes is the captured triage assessment. Acuity belongs to initial assessment; arrival and admission decision remain separate from physical placement.
capability: MEDICINE and SURGERY are adult med-surg flex wards, with preferred responsibility and reciprocal overflow capability for selected postoperative and medical cohorts. Fill compatible shared rooms before opening new rooms. A configured 20 percent of acuity 2 medical admissions, plus acuity 1 medical admissions, have an initial two-day ICU stabilization requirement; stepdown retains the ICU bed until a compatible ward bed is ready. Stable adult ward patients can temporarily occupy otherwise idle ICU locations, retaining a soft buffer of one available ICU bed per site and requesting ward stepdown after twelve hours. WARD_OVERFLOW_ICU explicitly distinguishes physical location from intensive care service; no ICU clinical billing is inferred from bed type. This selected oral-care dataset is not a full ICU clinical record. OR scheduling and actual workforce coverage are integrated in Phase 5.
room_compatibility: Ordinary shared rooms require matching recorded M/F administrative sex. X or UNKNOWN registration values default to a private room; compatibility or consent is not inferred from names or from matching unknown values. A selected 20 percent of pneumonia care episodes have an explicit source placement-assessment document at admission recording suspected transmissible respiratory illness and requesting a private isolation-capable room. Such a patient occupies the room alone, including the empty neighboring bed restriction. Missing this selected indication uses the modeled standard-precaution pathway, not a claim that disease is absent. Preserve special-room availability by preferring ordinary beds for standard-precaution care. ICU rooms are single-bed. These are explicit fictional placement rules, not an infection-control protocol or a pathogen-based cohorting recommendation.
availability: Licensed, in-service, staffing-enabled, EMPTY, unreserved and patient-compatible are independent predicates. Occupied staffing shortfall never erases the patient. Planned maintenance starts only after a requested bed becomes empty and ready.
transfers: Ward transfer legs are atomic at one instant, retain encounter identity and have one correlation. Twelve continuous interhospital care episodes have separate recipient encounters and paired correlated bed legs, with explicit route-dependent transport/boarding gaps. They are excluded from new network admissions and readmissions. Other observed TRANSFER discharges leave the modeled network.
corrections: CORRECTION replaces the referenced assertion at its effective time. Earlier versions remain visible before correction delivery. Resolve the chain before replaying full post-states. A cancellation is RESERVE then RELEASE, with no occupant. Duplicate deliveries deduplicate by event ID and conflicting duplicate content fails.
demand: Seeded weighted calendar sampling conditions respiratory admissions on facility-specific winter curves, growth and the finite January-February 2024 surge. Realized daily indices become known only after the local day closes. Calendar knowledge has a separate earlier timestamp.
clinical_integration: Regenerate encounter histories, conditions, bookings, measurements, medications and grounded notes together from accepted immutable master rows. The accepted clinical snapshot remains immutable provenance, not a set of timestamps patched independently. Phase 5 may rerun this integrated candidate if labor or stock changes actual care.
counting: All scalar business rows, including twelve recipient encounters, openings, reservations and corrections, count within the frozen envelopes. Interval/current-state/queue projections are computed views; no extra business table or hidden fact array is published. Checkpoints and review extracts are separately reported mirrors.
review_scope: User-designated synthetic operational and domain plausibility review by Codex; no licensed clinical endorsement or final release acceptance.
unmet_demand: Acute first-placement requests are escalated to an observed external transfer after 24 hours without compatible capacity. The encounter, selected care evidence and an explicit placement-disposition source document remain. No receiving care or later death is invented after external transfer. The twelve accepted continuous network referrals retain their correlated receiving-care dependency. Elective arrivals are deferred to a weekday daytime bed offer; original booking slots remain visible separately from actual arrival. Zero unexplained unplaced completions is required, rather than forcing every admitted patient into a licensed bed.
terminal_scope: Thirty initial terminal clinical proposals are subject to actual network flow. If a patient is transferred outside the network first, later hypothetical death is unobserved and is not published. Observed deaths remain nonzero and cannot exceed that proposal cohort.
queue_policy: Critical acuity 1 requests always take precedence. To prevent starvation, elective requests deferred for at least seven days are promoted ahead of stable acuity 2/3 requests during weekday admission windows ending at 14:59 local. Original acuity remains unchanged; queue priority is an operational decision, not a rewritten clinical score. Acute compatible-capacity waits have a 24-hour external-transfer escalation. Accepted continuous network referrals retain their receiving-care dependency.
boarding_death: An observed death before a compatible bed is available remains a monitored-boarding death, with an explicit placement-disposition source document and no invented licensed-bed interval. This is distinct from a death that would occur after an external transfer, which remains unobserved and is not published.
elective_actual_hours: Original elective booking proposals remain weekday morning. Actual capacity-dependent arrivals may occur 07:00-14:59 local on weekdays, so an afternoon-ready bed can be used instead of artificially deferring to the next morning. The selected procedure follows three hours later. This is an explicit Phase 4 operational-scope addendum to the provisional clinical generator; the standalone Phase 3 validator retains its original 07:00-10:59 default. OR and staff constraints remain Phase 5 work.
boarding_clock: Boarding metrics begin at admission_decision_at, as required by the frozen scenario contract. The 24-hour external-transfer escalation is explicitly measured from admitted_at; decision-to-admission time is reported separately and included in total boarding. Occupied time excludes both portions. Cross-site transport is reported outside either facility care interval.
transport: Fictional ground-transport assumptions between the modeled Illinois cities: Peoria-Springfield 120 minutes, Peoria-Rockford 180 minutes, Rockford-Springfield 240 minutes, each plus a seeded 0-30 minute handover allowance. These are explicit synthetic operating assumptions, not quoted ambulance travel estimates. Preserve the route gap when sending care is delayed; receiving boarding is separate from transport.
continuation_referrals: Each selected continuous network referral has a prospective sending-facility coordination plan known at administrative admission, naming the accepted receiving hospital with actual handoff time still unknown. The receiving-facility coordination receipt is known at its own admission, confirms its observed arrival and leaves later outcomes unknown. These source documents justify retaining escalation within the accepted network referral rather than silently consulting a future outcome label. Documents move with actual care timing and are independently validated.
clinical_response: An administrative capacity transfer or accepted network continuation does not automatically imply clinical deterioration. The operational clinical generator preserves its seeded illness-response component independently of the transfer cause; observed death remains adverse.
